title: Class 3 as a holographic projection or laser plasmoids

tellings.quote: And we are forced to ask yourself, and it's still only theory: isn't everything in holographic sky projection?

plain: James Valor, from Skywatcher, a startup that says it tries to call UFOs into view, told podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025 a theory about one type of object his team sees, which they call Class 3. He says, while stressing it is only a theory, that they have been forced to ask whether these things are a kind of holographic projection in the sky, or glowing balls of charged gas made by lasers. If true, it would mean some of what people see is projected images rather than solid craft.
